composition.rule: The exact P1349 public contract and P1349 R2 blocker are immutable predecessors. P1350 replaces only bypassable route placement and absent durable progress evidence. P1349 result domains, reasons, counts, meta policy and inherited semantics remain exact.
composition.baseline_identity: All P1349 R2 executable and adversarial artifacts are identified transitively by p1349-verifier-blocker-r2 SHA-256; this contract does not inspect or repin their source implementations.

public_boundary_binding.operation_map_authority: The exact operation IDs are the frozen P1349 exact_ids set transported under the P1350 authority root. Adapter binds each ID exactly once to one internal route; callers cannot provide or override a route.
public_boundary_binding.edge_rule: For every focal invocation the only dynamic call path is batch caller -> public focal entry -> parent supervisor -> authenticated disposable executor -> one internal route. A source/runtime edge that skips any vertex is invalid.
public_boundary_binding.failure_rule: Supervisor setup, handshake, capability, pidfd/fallback, journal or route-map failure returns a terminal blocker after cleanup. No failure selects a direct inherited fallback.

focal_request.closed_rule: All fields required, no unknown or duplicate key, canonical order/encoding. case_id and operation must agree with the frozen exact_ids/operation map before fork.

route_binding.visibility: Parent receives only a frozen map digest and coverage proof. The route value is consumed inside the disposable executor and is absent from public request and result schemas.

handshake.closed_rule: Exactly one canonical control-pipe frame before ACK. PID/starttime/SID/PGID equal parent observations and SID == PGID == PID. capability equals the one-time opaque parent token.

request_and_route_schemas.classification_result: Exact p1349-classification-result-r1 closed schema; no supervisor, route, meta or blocker fields.
request_and_route_schemas.integration_blocker: Exact p1349-integration-blocker-r1 domain refined by the closed P1350 blocker-code, supervisor-evidence and journal-evidence schemas below; no classification or reason_code.
request_and_route_schemas.strictness: All envelopes use duplicate-key rejection, exact key order, canonical JSON and exact schema discriminator before semantic validation.

supervisor_evidence_schema.authority: Only the parent supervisor populates this evidence from retained FDs and syscalls after cleanup. Executor projection, adapter data and journal claims cannot overwrite it.

pid_pidfd_session_binding.spawn: Parent fork return supplies the exact child PID. Parent immediately reads /proc/<pid>/stat starttime and opens pidfd before accepting handshake.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.pidfd_success: Retain pidfd and fstat identity through waitid(P_PIDFD,pidfd,WEXITED|WNOWAIT), exact waitpid(child_pid,0), signal and close. PID/status disagreement is SUPERVISOR_AUTHORITY.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.fallback: Only ENOSYS permits pidfd_available=false. Journal errno and initial PID/starttime; before every PID or group signal and terminal interpretation re-read starttime and require equality plus direct-child wait ownership. Any ambiguity is AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.session: Executor calls setsid before handshake. Parent independently requires PPID equals itself and PID == SID == PGID. Every registered descendant retains the same SID/PGID.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.capability_formula: HMAC-SHA256(parent_random_32_bytes, RFC8785(["p1350-executor-capability-r1", run_id, sequence_index, case_id, operation, pid, starttime_ticks, nonce_32_bytes]))
pid_pidfd_session_binding.capability_use: One presentation in the handshake, one parent ACK and immediate consumption. Reuse, absence, cross-case exchange or presentation after deadline is SUPERVISOR_AUTHORITY.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.descendant_barrier: Executor reports each descendant while it is stopped or blocked before case work. Parent authenticates ancestry/session/starttime, opens pidfd or records allowed fallback and ACKs before continuation.
pid_pidfd_session_binding.no_stdout_authority: PID, starttime, pidfd, PPID, SID, PGID, signal, wait and group absence from stdout/result are never authoritative.

deadline_cleanup_binding.deadline_origin: Parent arms one absolute deadline after executor binding and before ACK. Child, adapter, route and environment cannot extend, reset or disable it.
normal_or_failure_order: stop accepting result bytes at terminal condition
send TERM to retained live pidfds and authenticated PGID if any member remains
send KILL to remaining pidfds and PGID
waitpid exact executor and reap every registered descendant
deadline_cleanup_binding.return_predicate: Only after the complete order and journal durability may the batch receive classification_result or integration_blocker.
deadline_cleanup_binding.external_cleanup: Any process requiring cleanup by a process outside this parent supervisor is terminal EXTERNAL_CLEANUP_REQUIRED and blocks without classification or score.

frame_binding.stdout_termination: exactly one LF after one canonical JSON object; no leading/trailing bytes
frame_binding.read_rule: Parent reads only its retained CLOEXEC endpoint under the case deadline, hashes exact bytes and waits for EOF. Frame parsing occurs before semantic acceptance but cannot bypass cleanup.
frame_binding.failure: Zero, missing, partial, duplicate, noncanonical, oversized, wrong-domain or trailing frame and nonempty stderr are FRAME_AUTHORITY blockers, never semantic reasons or Unknown.

journal_line_schema.nullable_by_event: Non-applicable fixed line_core fields are explicit null; omission is forbidden. case_id, operation and process fields are null only for run_complete.
journal_line_schema.durability: Complete append, fdatasync and independent canonical reread precede ACK, operation release, next case_start and final result release.

journal_state_machine_binding.signal_cardinality: zero or one term_sent; zero or one kill_sent; kill_sent requires prior term_sent and grace expiry
journal_state_machine_binding.single_active_case: case_start requires no active case and next order; case_result closes that exact case. Another case_start before durable close is invalid.
journal_state_machine_binding.run_complete: Exactly one final run_complete after every expected case has one case_result and no live/active process group. Its order equals last case order plus one and its previous hash equals the last case_result current hash.
journal_state_machine_binding.report_boundary: Parser returns journal validity, active/last case and cleanup facts. It never returns or reconstructs semantic classification/reason.

cardinality_rules: unexpected_integration_blockers equals returned blocker count outside X06/X15 meta observations
journal_receipt_schema.pin_order: Receipt is authored only after journal FD close and parser success; it pins the whole-file journal SHA-256 and final line hash. Verifier report consumes receipt. Journal and receipt do not pin each other cyclically.

blocker_precedence_exact: semantic classification precedence inherited from P1349
unknown_blocker_and_reason_binding.meta_rule: Only exact planned internal blockers in the two disposable meta cases can become meta PASS after state/restoration/journal/cleanup checks. All other blockers are terminal, increment unexpected_integration_blockers and stop later gates.
unknown_blocker_and_reason_binding.score_rule: mutation_score = focal_correctly_violated / focal_valid_negatives. A blocker, meta result, control or Unknown never enters numerator or denominator. The frozen focal denominator is 254.

attacks_controls_cardinality_binding.coverage_acceptance: 60 declared unique operations = 60 supervised bindings = 12 local/new + 48 inherited; zero unbound, duplicate or direct inherited edges.
attacks_controls_cardinality_binding.dynamic_acceptance: Every valid negative normally terminates under its own supervisor with exact Violated/reason. Deliberate supervisor/journal protocol corruptions prove fail-closed in isolated adversarial invocations and cannot release the main verification chain.
attacks_controls_cardinality_binding.control_acceptance: Meta 2/2 and eleven controls preserve exact P1349 results. Normal/repeat/reverse use distinct run IDs, journals, capabilities, processes and registries, return identical normalized semantic vectors and leave zero residual resources.

required_artifacts: independent oracle checker/caller/supervisor/journal parser and authorship receipt
independent adversary suite and authorship receipt
causal_edges: P1350 spec + binding -> P1350 contract receipt
journal receipt + execution results -> verifier report/attestation

root_formulas.contract_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1350-contract-root-r1", step_p1350_sha256, p1349_blocker_r2_sha256, p1349_contract_spec_sha256, p1349_contract_binding_sha256, p1349_contract_receipt_sha256, p1350_contract_spec_sha256, p1350_contract_binding_sha256]))
root_formulas.execution_authority_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1350-execution-authority-root-r1", contract_root_sha256, oracle_checker_sha256, oracle_caller_sha256, supervisor_sha256, journal_parser_sha256, oracle_authorship_receipt_sha256, adversary_suite_sha256, adversary_authorship_receipt_sha256, adapter_sha256, adapter_authorship_receipt_sha256]))
root_formulas.delivery_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1350-delivery-root-r1", execution_authority_root_sha256, caller_sha256, checker_sha256, supervisor_sha256, journal_parser_sha256, adversary_suite_sha256, adapter_sha256]))

receipt_and_authority_binding.acyclicity: Every hash edge points to an already frozen predecessor. No artifact self-pins or pins a successor. Contract/authorship receipts precede caller and delivery; delivery whole-file hash arrives out of band. Journal receipt follows closed journal and precedes report.
receipt_and_authority_binding.preseal_anchor: Independent verifier receives delivery-receipt SHA-256 out of band before import/execution. Limited preseal receives verifier receipt/report/attestation and journal-receipt SHA-256 out of band; no candidate supplies its own anchor.
receipt_and_authority_binding.role_write_allowlists: Each authority records exact readable and writable paths, executor, environment, inherited context, predecessor hashes, output hashes, cost and revision. Verifier writes only report/attestation/receipt/preseal or blocker and never corrects inputs.

release_predicates.G06: all focal boundary attacks exact, controls preserved, no external cleanup or residual resources
release_predicates.G07: meta=2/2; X14+11 variants timely exact; zero unexpected blocker
release_predicates.G08: remaining P1348 exact; P1347=39/39; P1346=181/181; controls=11/11
release_predicates.G09: three complete fresh runs, identical normalized semantic vector, distinct runtime identities, valid journals
release_predicates.G10: mutation_score=1.0; focal_valid_negatives=254; zero survivors/regressions/unexpected blockers/transport Unknown; semantic Unknown exactly one

gate_order_binding.stop_before_next: Any false predicate stops before the next gate and emits a reproducible blocker with the last durable journal line.

budgets_and_forbidden_bindings.stop: Two attempts on the same cause without gain, external cleanup, any residual process/FD/state, journal without active-case identity, coverage below 60/60, unexpected blocker, survivor, reason relaxation, protected drift or scope expansion blocks without waiver.
forbidden: unsupervised focal route or direct inherited fallback
route or supervisor toggle supplied by caller
executor reuse or batch-owned inherited runtime
deadline authored or extended outside parent supervisor
result returned before group absence and durable case_result
blocker or transport failure treated as Unknown or score credit
productive full corpus, RED, candidate, 38 capsules, L0/consumer change, final certificate or general-equivalence claim

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. Public boundary, 60/60 coverage, schemas, PID/pidfd/session capability, deadline/cleanup, frames, journal grammar/state/receipt, Unknown/blocker policy, cardinalities, authority DAG, gate order and budgets are closed. Duplicate/unknown keys or alternate bindings are invalid.
